external_assessment.note: Required for Class A (FRC-CLA-ASF, FRC-CLA-EAM). Model the alternative-framework assessment as references; do NOT store confidential reports in this repository. All values TBD in the template.
external_assessment.framework: TBD: SOC 2 Type II | FedRAMP Ready | GovRAMP | other alternative security framework
external_assessment.assessment_date: TBD: YYYY-MM-DD (must be within the previous 12 months per FRC-CLA-ASF)
external_assessment.assessor: TBD: name of the assessing organization

materials_item_schema.uri: location reference (the report itself is NOT stored in this repository)

fedramp_independent_assessment.note: FRC-APP-FIA: a FRESH initial FedRAMP independent assessment completed by a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service within the previous 3 months. Class B and C MUST supply this; Class A MAY. Distinct from external_assessment (the Class A alternative-framework path). FRC-APP-USA allows a Recognized assessor to freshen a stale assessment unless it is more than 9 months old. All values TBD in the template.
fedramp_independent_assessment.assessor_name: TBD: name of the FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service
fedramp_independent_assessment.assessor_fedramp_id: TBD: the assessor's FedRAMP Recognition id
fedramp_independent_assessment.completed_at: TBD: YYYY-MM-DD the assessment was completed (must be within the previous 3 months for B/C)
fedramp_independent_assessment.assessment_summary_uri: TBD: location of the overall assessment summary (IVV-IAS-OSA)
fedramp_independent_assessment.assessment_report_uri: TBD: location reference (the report is NOT stored in this repository)
fedramp_independent_assessment.assessment_report_sha256: TBD: hash of the referenced report

overall_assessment_summary: [SAMPLE - fictional] overall_assessment_summary for Acme Cloud Widgets.

cpo_last_updated: [SAMPLE - fictional] cpo_last_updated for Acme Cloud Widgets.
cpo_source_of_update: [SAMPLE - fictional] cpo_source_of_update for Acme Cloud Widgets.

cpo_required_information.note: CPO-CSO-OVR: for each referenced rule, a pointer to (or summary of) the information in the CPO. Anything left unset is a preflight blocker. Keys are rule ids: CPO-CSO-MTD, CDS-CSO-PUB, CDS-CSO-SVC, CDS-CSO-IRP, MAS-CSO-IIR, MAS-CSO-FLO, MAS-CSO-TPR, CMU-CSO-CMD, IVV-CSO-ICP. Omit a key only if the rule genuinely does not apply to this class/type.

availability_reporting.note: CDS-CSO-AVR: a web service showing current and >=30 days historical core-service availability (including incidents) in both human-readable and machine-readable formats, available even when the primary offering is down. Class B and C MUST; Class A SHOULD. This repository references the provider's service; it does not host it.
availability_reporting.human_readable_uri: TBD: URL of the human-readable availability page
availability_reporting.machine_readable_uri: TBD: URL of the machine-readable availability feed
availability_reporting.available_when_primary_unavailable: TBD: true/false (independently hosted); human-verified, not machine-asserted
availability_reporting.verified_at: TBD: YYYY-MM-DD the provider verified the service

application_prerequisites.note: Checked by `sdr.py application-preflight` (not package-preflight). FedRAMP's applying rules require the provider to be listed in the FedRAMP Marketplace and to complete the FedRAMP Certification Application Form. These are external prerequisites, referenced here, not properties of the generated package.
application_prerequisites.marketplace_listing_uri: TBD: URL of the provider's FedRAMP Marketplace listing
application_prerequisites.application_form_reference: TBD: reference/confirmation of the completed FedRAMP Certification Application Form

evidence_sources.note: Optional third-party evidence sources, opt-in per customer. Off by default. Set enabled=true and point export_path at a customer-produced export (produced in the customer's own environment; this repository holds no API client or credentials). See automation/collectors/thirdparty_adapters.py.
